meta.title: 3D to 2D Dish - Distortion Lab Configuration
meta.description: Parameters and mathematical definitions for Tissot Indicatrices, developable surface cases, and perspective transitions

areaScale.name: Area Distortion (s)
areaScale.explanation: Ratio of the area of the infinitesimal ellipse of distortion to that of the infinitesimal circle on the sphere. Equal-area projections maintain s = 1.0 everywhere.

angularDeformation.name: Maximum Angular Deformation (2ω)
angularDeformation.explanation: Maximum alteration in the angle between any two intersecting directions. Conformal projections maintain 2ω = 0° (a = b) everywhere.

scaleAlongMeridian.name: Meridian Scale Factor (h)
scaleAlongMeridian.explanation: Scale factor along the meridian passing through the point.

scaleAlongParallel.name: Parallel Scale Factor (k)
scaleAlongParallel.explanation: Scale factor along the parallel of latitude passing through the point.

azimuthalPerspectiveType.name: Gnomonic
azimuthalPerspectiveType.property: Great circles are straight lines (aviation/shipping routes)

azimuthalPerspectiveType.name: Stereographic
azimuthalPerspectiveType.property: Conformal; all circles on sphere remain circles on map

azimuthalPerspectiveType.name: General Perspective
azimuthalPerspectiveType.viewpoint: Finite altitude in orbit (e.g. 2 Earth radii)
azimuthalPerspectiveType.property: True satellite viewpoint from space with adjustable horizon

azimuthalPerspectiveType.name: Orthographic
azimuthalPerspectiveType.property: Natural visual globe as seen from deep space

cases.label: Tangent Case
cases.description: Developable surface touches sphere along a single line (or point). Scale factor k = 1.0 along the line, increasing outward.

cases.label: Secant Case
cases.description: Surface cuts through sphere, creating two lines (or a small circle) of zero distortion (k = 1.0). Scale factor is < 1 between lines, > 1 outside.
